content: The format of the data in the destination buffer (DestBuffer) of the function Dem_GetEventFreezeFrameDataEx is raw hexadecimal values and con- tains no header-information like RecordNumber or DataId. The size of the buffer equals to the configuration settings of all respective data elements.
